lines.en: label dormwartwo7:
scene comedywar1
: Thanks again for tuning in to our live coverage of the second annual Super Mega Ultimate Dorm Wars: Halloween Version!
lines.zh: : 再次感谢各位收看第二届「超级无敌终极宿舍大战：万圣节版」的现场直播！

lines.en: : I’m your host, Molly MacCormack, and joining me right now is none other than everyone’s favorite Pokemon trainer and queen of questionable doujinshi...Misty!
lines.zh: : 我是你们的主持人 Molly MacCormack，此刻和我一起的，不是别人，正是大家最爱的宝可梦训练家、堪称问题同人志女王的……小霞！

lines.en: scene comedywar2
: Who...also happens to be wearing Ash’s hat for some reason.
lines.zh: : 不知道为什么……她头上还戴着小智的帽子。

lines.en: : He left it at my place after a night of passionate lovemaking.
lines.zh: : 一夜激情之后，他把帽子落在我家了。

lines.en: : Aren’t they canonically 10?
lines.zh: : 他们官方设定不是才十岁吗？

lines.en: : When has that ever stopped literally anyone?
lines.zh: : 这种事什么时候真的拦住过任何人？

lines.en: : That is a fair point and one that I relate to more than I would like to admit.
lines.zh: : 这话有道理，而且我比自己愿意承认的还要有共鸣。

lines.en: scene comedywar1
: However! Right now is not the time to discuss our taboo habits and hobbies! But it {i}is{/i} time to discuss what sort of thing Kirin’s roommate, Noriko Nakayama, and our beloved teacher are up to!
lines.zh: : 不过！现在可不是讨论我们那些禁忌癖好和爱好的时候！现在{i}该{/i}讨论的是，Kirin 的室友 Noriko Nakayama，和我们敬爱的老师，究竟在搞什么名堂！

lines.en: scene comedywar3
: Kirin, with Noriko’s lead in the official polls {i}still{/i} on the rise, what do you have to say about how their date might be going right now? Any ideas or insight on how things are playing out?
lines.zh: : Kirin，Noriko 在官方投票里的领先优势{i}还{/i}在扩大，你觉得他们的这场约会现在进展如何？对事态的发展有什么想法或见解吗？

lines.en: : Well, hopefully, they’re fucking.
lines.zh: : 嗯，希望他们正在操。

lines.en: scene comedywar4
: Uhh...any...{i}other{/i} ideas or insight?
lines.zh: : 呃……还有……{i}别的{/i}想法或者见解吗？

lines.en: : Sure. I can elaborate if that’s what you want.
lines.zh: : 当然。如果你想听，我可以展开讲讲。

lines.en: : That’s not what I-
lines.zh: : 我不是那个——

lines.en: : Hopefully, Noriko sidelined whatever sappy, emotional plans she put together for tonight and is currently riding our teacher’s dick like it’s Kingda Ka.
lines.zh: : 希望 Noriko 把她为今晚准备的那套又酸又煽情的计划放到一边，现在正像坐 Kingda Ka 过山车一样骑着我们老师的老二。

lines.en: : Because, let’s face it folks- she kind of needs it at this point, doesn’t she?
lines.zh: : 因为说实话，各位——到这个地步，她确实挺需要的，不是吗？

lines.en: : All this “will they, won’t they” bullshit is getting really tiring and if I have to hear her vent about it one more time, I'm going to knock her unconscious and let Sensei have his way with her while she’s asleep.
lines.zh: : 这套「他们到底会不会在一起」的废话真是越来越烦人了，要是再让我听她发一次牢骚，我就把她打晕，让老师趁她睡着的时候对她为所欲为。

lines.en: scene comedywar5
: Oh. Shit. Whoops. Probably shouldn’t have said that in front of you, huh? Not trying to poke at a sore spot or anything.
lines.zh: : 哦。操。哎呀。这话大概不该当着你的面说，对吧？我不是故意要戳你的痛处什么的。

lines.en: scene comedywar6
: What...exactly do you mean by-
lines.zh: : 你……具体是什么意思——

lines.en: : Listen, all that matters about tonight’s date with Noriko and Sensei is that she gets railed so hard that she has no further desire to talk about it with me.
lines.zh: : 听着，今晚 Noriko 和老师这场约会，唯一重要的就是她被干到爽得再也不想来跟我聊这件事。

lines.en: : So long as that happens, everyone will be happy and we can finally start preparing for Threesome-Thursdays.
lines.zh: : 只要做到这一点，大家都会开心，我们也能终于开始筹备「星期四三人行」了。

lines.en: : Threesome...Thursdays?
lines.zh: : 星期四……三人行？

lines.en: scene comedywar7
: You’re invited too, of course. I’ve always fantasized about going down on a white girl.
lines.zh: : 当然也邀请你。我一直都幻想过给一个白人女孩口交。

lines.en: scene comedywar8
: Oh, look! The man of the hour has returned! Let’s check in with him to see how everything went!
lines.zh: : 哦，快看！今天的男主角回来了！让我们去问问他，看看一切进展如何！

lines.en: : Senpai! It’s about time you showed up!
lines.zh: : 前辈！你可算来了！

lines.en: scene black
I make my way into the cafe for the stand-up comedy thing and immediately steal the attention of roughly half of the room.
lines.zh: 我走进咖啡馆参加这场单口相声活动，立刻就抢走了大约半屋子人的注意力。

lines.en: It’s not exactly {i}good{/i} attention, though, as the vast majority of it is jealous glares and pointed glances that scream “Why couldn’t it be me?”
lines.zh: 不过那算不上什么{i}好{/i}的注意力，因为绝大多数都是嫉妒的瞪视和意味深长的目光，仿佛在喊「为什么不是我？」

lines.en: But at least I can count on Imani to not bother me about it.
lines.zh: 但至少 Imani 肯定是不会为这种事来烦我的。

lines.en: scene comedywar9
: So, did you get it wet?
lines.zh: : 那么，弄湿了吗？

lines.en: : How come you never take me on any dates? I like being pampered too, you know.
lines.zh: : 为什么你从来不带我去约会？我也喜欢被人伺候啊，你知道吗。

lines.en: : I didn’t exactly do any “pampering” when today was all about the girls pleasing {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 今天整场都是女孩们在取悦我，{i}我{/i}可没「伺候」过谁。

lines.en: : Ahh. So you {i}did{/i} get it wet.
lines.zh: : 啊哈。所以你{i}确实{/i}弄湿了。

lines.en: : Noriko back at home “recharging” right now? Because I did notice Futaba moving a little slower than usual and I can only imagine what that must mean.
lines.zh: : Noriko 现在在家里「充电」吧？因为我确实注意到 Futaba 走路的动作比平时慢了点，那意味着什么，我只能自己想象了。

lines.en: : Hey, how about we talk about something else? That sounds fun.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我们换个话题怎么样？听起来挺有意思的。

lines.en: : You’ve gotta at least tell me who won. I’m still your co-judge at the end of the day, even if I didn’t get to tag along and watch you rail our students.
lines.zh: : 你至少得告诉我谁赢了。说到底我还是你的副裁判呢，虽然我没能跟着去看你干我们的学生。

lines.en: : Is that something you’d be interested in?
lines.zh: : 你对那种事感兴趣吗？

lines.en: : My mind and the rational part of me says no, but my heart is telling me yes.
lines.zh: : 我的理智和理性的那部分在说不想，但我的心在说想。

lines.en: scene comedywar10
: Ooh, maybe if I just sat in the corner with one of my eyes like this? I could play both sides that way, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 哦哦，要不我就这样在角落里睁一只眼坐着？那样我就能两边都占了，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: scene comedywar9
: You’re boring tonight.
lines.zh: : 你今晚真无聊。

lines.en: : And you’re as “fun” as ever.
lines.zh: : 而你还是一如既往地「有趣」。

lines.en: : But when it comes to who won...
lines.zh: : 不过说到谁赢了……

lines.en: menu seconddatechoice:
Futaba
lines.zh: Futaba

lines.en: : I think...I have to give it to Futaba.
lines.zh: : 我觉得……我得把这一票投给 Futaba。

lines.en: scene comedywar11
$ dorm1war2points += 1
$ datewarfutaba = True
: Oh yeah? I guess polls really are just polls then, huh?
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？看来投票终归只是投票，对吧？

lines.en: : Why Futaba? Any particular reason?
lines.zh: : 为什么是 Futaba？有什么特别的理由吗？

lines.en: : It was just...closer to an ideal “date” for me, I think.
lines.zh: : 只是……它更接近我理想中的「约会」，我觉得。

lines.en: : The time I had with Noriko was really...special, for lack of a better term- but I’m not exactly sure if I’d call it fun.
lines.zh: : 我和 Noriko 在一起的时光真的很……特别，找不到更好的词了——但我不太确定我会不会把它叫做有趣。

lines.en: : Or if...I even had a {i}good{/i} time to begin with. It was just...a lot.
lines.zh: : 或者……我到底有没有{i}开心{/i}过。那只是……太多了。

lines.en: : But with Futaba, there was this clear desire to make sure I had a good time. And nearly everything we did was all about me.
lines.zh: : 但和 Futaba 在一起时，能明显感觉到她想让我开心。而且我们做的几乎每一件事都是围着我转的。

lines.en: : I see, I see. Futaba wins because all you care about is yourself. Got it.
lines.zh: : 明白了，明白了。Futaba 赢，是因为你只在乎你自己。懂了。

lines.en: : It’s not just that. It was clear she was sharing a piece of her past with me as well. Or...showing me a side of herself that no one else is allowed to see or...something like that.
lines.zh: : 不只是这样。很明显，她也把自己的一段过去分享给了我。或者……让我看到了她不允许别人看到的那一面……大概是这样。

lines.en: scene comedywar12
: Well...I’m happy for ya, chief.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我为你高兴啊，老大。

lines.en: : I’ll be the one to break the news to Noriko, but we should probably let her rest for now.
lines.zh: : 由我去把这个消息告诉 Noriko 吧，不过现在大概还是让她先休息一下。

lines.en: : I know {i}I{/i} wouldn’t be happy if some dude used me up the way you used her and then tossed me aside for somebody else.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}知道，如果有个男的像你用她那样把我榨干，然后又为了别人把我甩到一边，我肯定不会高兴。

lines.en: : That’s not what-
lines.zh: : 事情不是——

lines.en: : Blah, blah, blah. We’re getting ready to start soon, so go do your “mingling” thing while I do what I do best and handle all of the clerical work.
lines.zh: : 巴拉巴拉巴拉。马上就要开始了，你去忙你的「社交」吧，我去做我最擅长的事，把所有的文书工作搞定。

lines.en: Noriko
lines.zh: Noriko

lines.en: : I think...I have to give it to Noriko.
lines.zh: : 我觉得……我得把这一票投给 Noriko。

lines.en: $ dorm2war2points += 1
$ datewarnoriko = True
scene comedywar11
: Yeah. I had a feeling things were going to end up that way.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我早就觉得事情会走到这一步。

lines.en: : You did?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : Well, considering the first encounter I ever had with you involved that poor girl spilling her heart out in the middle of the hallway, I guess I’ve just got...some idea of the relationship you two have.
lines.zh: : 嗯，想想我和你的第一次相遇，就是那个可怜的女孩在走廊中间把心掏出来的场景，我想我对你们俩的关系……多少有点概念。

lines.en: : And I don’t just mean that in a creepy way that equates to me enabling you to bang a teenage girl without risk of both persecution and prosecution.
lines.zh: : 我这么说不只是在那种变态的意义上——也就是我纵容你干一个十几岁的女孩，还不用担心被告发或者被起诉。

lines.en: : I mean I know she’s special to you.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我知道她对你来说很特别。

lines.en: : To tell the truth...I think Futaba’s “date” was better overall. It was a lot more suited to my tastes and...it was clear that she put a load of thought into exactly what would make me happy.
lines.zh: : 说实话……我觉得 Futaba 的那场「约会」整体上更好。它更符合我的口味，而且……很明显她花了很多心思去想，到底什么能让我开心。

lines.en: : Noriko just...went above and beyond that, I guess.
lines.zh: : 而 Noriko 只是……比那还要更上一层楼吧，我想。

lines.en: : Yeah. She does that sometimes.
lines.zh: : 嗯。她有时候就会这样。

lines.en: : I’ll be the one to break the news to Futaba, but it’ll probably happen tomorrow since she seems to be having a good time tonight and I wouldn’t want to ruin that.
lines.zh: : 由我去把这个消息告诉 Futaba 吧，不过大概要等到明天——她今晚看起来玩得正开心，我不想扫她的兴。

lines.en: : Thanks, Imani.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Imani。

lines.en: : No prob, Senpai. We’re in this together, remember?
lines.zh: : 不客气，前辈。我们是一条船上的，记得吗？

lines.en: : Now, you go do your thing and mingle or whatever while I do what I do best and handle all of the clerical stuff.
lines.zh: : 好了，你去忙你的、去社交什么的，我去做我最擅长的事，把所有的文书工作搞定。

lines.en: : I can’t imagine there’s that much clerical work involved with the Dorm Wars.
lines.zh: : 我实在想不到宿舍大战能有多少文书工作。

lines.en: : You’d be surprised.
lines.zh: : 你会惊讶的。

lines.en: scene black
: I’ll catch up with you later, though! Enjoy the show, Senpai!
lines.zh: : 不过我待会儿再找你！好好看节目吧，前辈！

lines.en: : I’ll...do my best.
lines.zh: : 我……尽量。

lines.en: scene comedywar13
: Hey, I didn’t realize you were coming to-
lines.zh: : 嘿，我不知道你也会来——

lines.en: : Shh. This hasn’t happened since she was six and I will not let you take this from me.
lines.zh: : 嘘。这种事从她六岁起就没再发生过了，我不会让你把它从我手里抢走。

lines.en: : Also, I hope you’re a sub- because you’re about to get {i}mommed{/i} tonight.
lines.zh: : 另外，希望你是受的那方——因为今晚你要{i}被妈妈照顾{/i}了。

lines.en: : I see what you did there.
lines.zh: : 我懂你这话的双关。

lines.en: : Like...how’d your dates go or whatevs, Teach? You guys vibe?
lines.zh: : 比如……你们的约会怎么样啊什么的，老师？你们来电吗？

lines.en: scene comedywar14
: Ah! You were vibing without me?
lines.zh: : 啊！你们背着我来电了？

lines.en: : I don’t think she means that kind of vibe, Maki.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她说的不是那种来电，Maki。

lines.en: : You underestimate my knowledge of the vibe, good sir.
lines.zh: : 你低估了我对「来电」的理解，好先生。

lines.en: : This one is intangible.
lines.zh: : 这一种是摸不着的。

lines.en: scene comedywar15
: An intangible vibe?...That’s either the most...amazing or...terrifying thing I have ever heard of. My interest is piqued.
lines.zh: : 摸不着的来电？……那要么是我听过最……奇妙的东西，要么就是最……吓人的东西。我被勾起兴趣了。

lines.en: : The “vibes” were good, Miku.
lines.zh: : 「来电」挺好的，Miku。

lines.en: : Bet.
lines.zh: : 懂了。

lines.en: : On...what?
lines.zh: : 赌……什么？

lines.en: scene comedywar16
: Ohmygod, you’re like...so out of touch with reality. It’s hilarious.
lines.zh: : 我的天，你真的……太脱离现实了。太好笑了。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...you’re weird when you’re like this.
lines.zh: : 是吗，好吧……你这副样子才奇怪呢。

lines.en: : Ratio.
lines.zh: : 反杀。

lines.en: : Who on earth taught you this language? Because it sure as Hell wasn’t me.
lines.zh: : 到底是谁教你说这种话的？反正肯定不是我。

lines.en: scene comedywar17
: Why am I here? What benefit does my presence provide you? I don’t even like comedy. Or pastries. Or...mahogany. It’s too annoying to work with.
lines.zh: : 我为什么在这儿？我的存在对你有什么好处？我根本不喜欢喜剧。也不喜欢糕点。还有……红木。那东西加工起来太烦人了。

lines.en: : Your presence is like a soft breeze on a summer day...a solitary rain drop in the midst of a drought.
lines.zh: : 你的存在就像夏日里的一阵微风……干旱中的一滴孤雨。

lines.en: : Listen, Uta- I don’t know much about kunoichi, but I’m pretty sure they didn’t communicate entirely through metaphors.
lines.zh: : 听着，Uta——我对女忍者了解不多，但我很确定她们不是全靠隐喻来交流的。

lines.en: scene comedywar18
: To be sure of anything is to submit. Remain vigilant. Question all things. For it is only then that you will truly reach enlightenment.
lines.zh: : 对任何事确信不疑，就等于臣服。保持警觉。质疑一切。因为只有那样，你才能真正抵达开悟。

lines.en: : Now you just sound like a monk.
lines.zh: : 你现在听起来就像个和尚。

lines.en: : Perhaps I am. Perhaps we are {i}all{/i} monks- for monks are one with the world and its spiritual energies and we are but conduits when viewed through the eyes of an eagle.
lines.zh: : 也许我是。也许我们{i}都{/i}是和尚——因为和尚与世界及其灵性能量合为一体，而透过鹰的眼睛看去，我们不过是一根根导管。

lines.en: : {i}What?{/i}
scene comedywar17
: Your presence is a necessary evil. For if the need to communicate with my peers arises, I can not rely on the shadows alone. I need someone who can touch them with her bare hands.
lines.zh: : 你的存在是一种必要的恶。因为一旦需要和我的同伴沟通，我就不能只依靠影子。我需要一个能用赤手触碰影子的人。

lines.en: : Oh. So you just need a translator and no one else knows you well enough to understand your ninjaspeak.
lines.zh: : 哦。所以你只是需要一个翻译，因为没别人够了解你、听得懂你的忍者话。

lines.en: : Hai.
: Fine. But you’re going to owe me a favor if I actually have to apply those skills at any point.
lines.zh: : 行吧。不过要是我真得动用那些技能，你就欠我一个人情。

lines.en: : Your wish is my command.
lines.zh: : 你的愿望就是我的命令。

lines.en: scene comedywar19
: Hey! Welcome back! How’d your dates go?
lines.zh: : 嘿！欢迎回来！你们的约会怎么样？

lines.en: : They went well. Though, choosing a winner was a lot harder than I would have liked it to be.
lines.zh: : 挺顺利的。不过，选出一个赢家比我想要的要难多了。

lines.en: : I’m sure you...made the right choice...Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我相信你……做了正确的选择……老师……

lines.en: : As long as...that choice...was Futaba...
lines.zh: : 只要……那个选择……是 Futaba……

lines.en: scene comedywar20
: Wow. That’s...not the sort of answer I would have expected out of you, Sana. Especially considering the other competitor was one of your club-mates.
lines.zh: : 哇。这……可不像是我会期待从你嘴里说出的回答，Sana。尤其考虑到另一位竞争者还是你社团里的同伴。

lines.en: : Our floor comes before our club tonight, Sensei. If us first floor girls are going to win this war, we need to unite whenever we can. And if that means exiling our friends, so be it.
lines.zh: : 今晚我们楼层比社团重要，老师。如果我们一楼的女孩想赢下这场战争，就得抓住一切机会团结起来。如果那意味着要把朋友放逐，那就放逐吧。

lines.en: : You want to weigh in on this, Otoha? Or are you just going to keep staring at me?
lines.zh: : 你想说点什么吗，Otoha？还是说你就打算一直这么盯着我看？

lines.en: scene comedywar21
: I don’t know. I’m having a harder time than usual figuring out what I’m supposed to say to you right now.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我比平常更难想出，此刻该对你说什么。

lines.en: : What? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？

lines.en: : Does it matter? I’m just some random teenage girl. Who cares what I think?
lines.zh: : 有区别吗？我只是个随随便便的十几岁女孩。谁会在乎我怎么想？

lines.en: : Why are you acting so weird? All Sensei did was try to involve you in the conversation.
lines.zh: : 你干嘛这么怪？老师不过是想让你也参与进对话里而已。

lines.en: : Did I do something to offend you? Because we’ve barely even talked lately and I’m not really sure where this hostility is coming from.
lines.zh: : 我做什么冒犯到你了吗？我们最近几乎没怎么说过话，我真的搞不懂你这股敌意是从哪儿来的。

lines.en: : Hostility? Is not throwing myself at you the same thing as “hostility” now?
lines.zh: : 敌意？难道没有主动往你身上贴，现在也算「敌意」了吗？

lines.en: scene comedywar22
: Otoha, what the fuck is your problem? Stop being such a bitch. Sensei obviously wasn’t expecting you to {i}throw{/i} yourself at him.
lines.zh: : Otoha，你他妈到底有什么毛病？别这么刻薄。老师显然没指望你往他身上{i}贴{/i}。

lines.en: : How should I know that when he’s been running around with our classmates all day?
lines.zh: : 他整天和我们班上的同学到处乱跑，我怎么知道？

lines.en: : Just because he’s in a little fake date contest with a couple of the girls in class doesn’t mean he’s {i}fucking{/i} them.
lines.zh: : 他和班上几个女生搞那个假的约会比赛，不代表他就在跟她们{i}上床{/i}。

lines.en: scene comedywar23
: Wh...What’s that, Ayane? You...suddenly need my help with something?...Okay...be right there...
lines.zh: : 什……什么，Ayane？你……突然需要我帮什么忙？……好……马上就来……

lines.en: : And if he is?
lines.zh: : 那如果他就是在呢？

lines.en: : Then that’s {i}his{/i} choice. And you don’t need to go getting yourself involved with-
lines.zh: : 那也是{i}他{/i}的选择。而且你没必要把自己牵扯进——

lines.en: : I’ve got this, Chika.
lines.zh: : 这个我来，Chika。

lines.en: : No. If she’s going to sit there insulting you, I-
lines.zh: : 不行。她要是就这么坐着侮辱你，我——

lines.en: : I said I’ve got this.
lines.zh: : 我说了这个我来。

lines.en: scene comedywar24
: Tch. Whatever.
lines.zh: : 啧。随你便。

lines.en: : Do you want to talk, Otoha?
lines.zh: : 你想聊聊吗，Otoha？

lines.en: : Not really.
lines.zh: : 不太想。

lines.en: : Are you mad at me?
lines.zh: : 你在生我的气吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : Should I leave you alone?
lines.zh: : 那我该让你一个人待着吗？

lines.en: : Probably.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: scene black
: Okay. Then, I guess I’ll see you later.
lines.zh: : 好。那么，我想我们回头见。

lines.en: : Wha- Sensei! What part of that was “I got this?!” You just let her win!
lines.zh: : 什——老师！这哪里体现出「这个我来」了？！你就这么让她赢了！

lines.en: : No, I’d be letting her win if I spent any amount of time dwelling on whatever she’s pissed off about right now. No point in starting a fight over something I don’t even understand.
lines.zh: : 不，我要是花哪怕一点时间去纠结她现在到底在气什么，那才是让她赢。为了一件我根本不明白的事吵起来，没有意义。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : Just leave it alone. Whatever it is will resolve itself on its own.
lines.zh: : 别管了。不管是什么，它自己会解决的。

lines.en: scene comedywar25
: What was that about?
lines.zh: : 那是怎么回事？

lines.en: : I didn’t realize you were listening.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你在听。

lines.en: : I just happened to be looking in that general direction for some reason.
lines.zh: : 我只是不知怎么的，正好往那个大概的方向看了一眼。

lines.en: : Is it because of Chika’s costume?
lines.zh: : 是因为 Chika 的那身装扮吗？

lines.en: : Whaaaat? Noooooo. That’s crazy talk. I was just making sure...everyone’s drinks are full.
lines.zh: : 什——么？当——然不是。别瞎说。我只是在确认……每个人的杯子都满了。

lines.en: : Haru-chan, I don’t understand this “POS system” nonsense. Back in my day, we just memorized the  numbers and took people’s money.
lines.zh: : Haru 酱，我搞不懂这套「POS 系统」的名堂。我们那个年代，只要把数字背下来，然后收钱就行了。

lines.en: scene comedywar26
: Sara, you’re 33. It {i}is{/i} your day.
lines.zh: : Sara，你才三十三岁。现在{i}就是{/i}你的年代。

lines.en: : Take that back. I’m still 18 at heart.
lines.zh: : 收回那句话。我心里还是十八岁。

lines.en: : I guess that explains the costume.
lines.zh: : 我想这就能解释那身装扮了。

lines.en: : Just because you’re a Z-cup and can pull off sultry, promiscuous witch costumes doesn’t mean that we all have to-
lines.zh: : 就因为你是 Z 罩杯、能hold住那种又骚又浪的女巫装，不代表我们就都得——

lines.en: : Ahem.
lines.zh: : 咳哼。

lines.en: scene comedywar27
: Oh, hello there! Welcome to Koi Cafe? What can I get you, Sir? Coffee? Tea? {i}Me?{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦，您好！欢迎光临 Koi Cafe？您要点什么，先生？咖啡？茶？还是{i}我{/i}？

lines.en: : Coffee, please.
lines.zh: : 咖啡，谢谢。

lines.en: scene comedywar28
: Yes, Sir. Coming right up.
lines.zh: : 好的，先生。马上就来。

lines.en: : Listen, uhh...I don’t want to be a downer, but I’d probably try staying away from Otoha and Rin for a little while. It seems like the two of them are dealing with some...animosity or something and...
lines.zh: : 听着，呃……我不想泼冷水，不过我大概会暂时离 Otoha 和 Rin 远一点。她们俩之间好像有某种……敌意之类的，而且……

lines.en: : I don’t want that to get even worse and wind up ruining their weekend.
lines.zh: : 我不想让事情变得更糟，最后把她们的周末给毁了。

lines.en: : Look at you, being all responsible and motherly despite having one of the healthiest and unblemished uteruses around.
lines.zh: : 瞧瞧你，明明拥有附近最健康、最完美无瑕的子宫之一，却还是这么有责任心、这么像个妈妈。

lines.en: scene comedywar29
: Uhh...
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : I have no idea why I said that. I’m so sorry.
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己为什么说了那句话。非常抱歉。

lines.en: : Who even...
lines.zh: : 到底谁……

lines.en: : {i}What?{/i}
: I have a healthy uterus too, you know.
lines.zh: : 我的子宫也很健康啊，你知道吗。

lines.en: scene black
: Okay. I’m going to leave now.
lines.zh: : 好。我要走了。

lines.en: : {i}What the fuck was that?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那到底是什么鬼？{/i}

lines.en: scene comedywar30
: Hi. Please hit me if I say anything about female reproductive organs.
lines.zh: : 你们好。如果我提到任何和女性生殖器官有关的东西，请直接打我。

lines.en: : Sorry, can you try that greeting one more time? My brain must have malfunctioned from seeing you on such short notice and made me hear something about...uhh...{i}stuff.{/i}
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你能把刚才那句问候再说一遍吗？一定是突然见到你让我的大脑故障了，让我听见了什么关于……呃……{i}那种东西{/i}的话。

lines.en: : How strange. It appears my brain had the same malfunction. Perhaps we should check the building for gas leaks before continuing to spend time here?
lines.zh: : 真奇怪。看来我的大脑也出现了同样的故障。也许我们该先检查一下这栋楼有没有燃气泄漏，再继续待在这里？

lines.en: : What I meant to say is hello and that I don’t often see you two together. In fact, I don’t think I’ve {i}ever{/i} seen you two together.
lines.zh: : 我本来想说的是你们好，还有我很少看到你们两个在一起。事实上，我觉得我{i}从没{/i}见过你们两个在一起。

lines.en: scene comedywar31
: We met briefly at last year’s Christmas party, but it wasn’t until just a short while ago that Karin-senpai and I finally spoke on our own.
lines.zh: : 我们在去年的圣诞派对上短暂见过一面，但直到不久之前，我和 Karin 学姐才终于单独说过话。

lines.en: : I approached her as I recognized her costume from a video game I convinced my mother to purchase for my sister and me recently. And I must say, she wears it quite well.
lines.zh: : 我认出她的装扮出自一款我最近说服妈妈买给我和妹妹的电子游戏，于是就上前搭话了。我得说，她穿这身非常合适。

lines.en: : Not as well as...uhh...whatever you’re supposed to be...
lines.zh: : 虽然没有……呃……你扮的那个角色那么合适……

lines.en: scene comedywar32
: Hasshaku-sama, of course! Though, I suppose I cannot fault you for not recognizing the costume without the hat.
lines.zh: : 当然是八尺大人！不过，没有帽子你认不出来，我想我也不能怪你。

lines.en: : I seem to have underestimated just how large it would be and have been repeatedly bumping into things all day long.
lines.zh: : 我似乎低估了它到底会有多大，结果一整天都在不停地撞到东西。

lines.en: : You have...a very interesting combination of hobbies, Touka...
lines.zh: : 你的爱好组合……非常有意思，Touka……

lines.en: scene comedywar33
: Thank you very much, Karin-senpai! My mother always says that versatility is what makes a woman stand out in her field! And as the heir to my family’s fortune, I-
lines.zh: : 非常感谢，Karin 学姐！我妈妈总说，多才多艺才是一个女人在自己的领域里脱颖而出的关键！而作为家族财产的继承人，我——

lines.en: : J...Just Karin is fine, you know? You don’t have to keep adding “Senpai” to it.
lines.zh: : 就……就叫 Karin 就好，你知道吗？你不用一直加「学姐」。

lines.en: scene comedywar34
: But I respect you and it would feel wrong dropping such an important honorific for the only senpai I’ve ever met.
lines.zh: : 可是我很尊敬你，而且对我唯一见过的这位学姐，把这么重要的敬称去掉会让我觉得不对劲。

lines.en: : I mean...I guess if it makes you happy...
lines.zh: : 我是说……如果这样让你开心的话……

lines.en: : Sorry, but do you two remember I’m here? Or would you like me to go somewhere else so you can keep falling in love without having to worry about being interrupted?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你们两位还记得我也在这儿吗？还是说你们想让我去别的地方，好让你们继续坠入爱河、不用担心被打断？

lines.en: scene comedywar35
: Love?! What is love?! Baby don’t hurt me! No more!
lines.zh: : 爱？！什么是爱？！宝贝别伤害我！不要了！

lines.en: : My, you’re just as exceptional at ruining the moment as ever.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，你破坏气氛的本事还是一如既往地出色。

lines.en: : Can’t two beautiful women have mutual respect for one another without a man imagining what it would be like for them to kiss?
lines.zh: : 两个漂亮的女人就不能互相尊重，而不用一个男人在旁边想象她们接吻是什么样子吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不能。

lines.en: : Lies. I have a great deal of respect for my mother and surely you haven’t imagined the two of {i}us{/i} kissing.
lines.zh: : 谎言。我非常尊敬我的母亲，你总不至于想象过{i}我和她{/i}接吻吧。

lines.en: : I have.
lines.zh: : 我想象过。

lines.en: scene comedywar36
: Ew! Sensei!
lines.zh: : 恶心！老师！

lines.en: : Haha! Lips are cool but how about we change the conversation topic?! Oh, I know! How does everyone feel about dogs?! Dogs are great, right?!
lines.zh: : 哈哈！嘴唇是很棒，不过我们换个话题怎么样？！哦，我知道了！大家觉得狗怎么样？！狗最棒了，对吧？！

lines.en: scene comedywar37
: Aww, Karin-senpai! I had no idea you were so bashful in the face of romance! How insanely adorable!
lines.zh: : 哎呀，Karin 学姐！我不知道你面对恋爱竟然这么害羞！真是可爱到离谱！

lines.en: : The fantasies are coming back.
lines.zh: : 那些幻想又回来了。

lines.en: scene comedywar38
: Hush, you. Please allow me this rare opportunity to attempt socializing with new people. I would like to hear Karin-senpai’s thoughts on what the best breed of dog is.
lines.zh: : 嘘，你别说话。请允许我把握住这个难得的机会，试着和新朋友社交一下。我想听听 Karin 学姐觉得什么品种的狗最好。

lines.en: : Doodles are nice. And soft. I like them.
lines.zh: : 贵宾混血犬很好。而且很软。我喜欢。

lines.en: : Yeah.
lines.zh: : 是啊。

lines.en: : This is nice. This makes me feel good.
lines.zh: : 这样真好。这让我心情很好。

lines.en: : Again, they’re back.
lines.zh: : 又来了，它们又回来了。

lines.en: : Shoo, you pest.
lines.zh: : 去一边去，你这个烦人精。

lines.en: scene black
I leave Touka and Karin to fall in love in private and continue on with my standard process of evenly distributing my time between everyone at the start of a party.
lines.zh: 我把 Touka 和 Karin 留在那里偷偷谈恋爱，继续按老规矩，在派对开始时把时间平均分配给每一个人。

lines.en: Or at least I {i}try{/i} to before something terrible happens.
lines.zh: 至少在可怕的事情发生之前，我是{i}打算{/i}这么做的。

lines.en: scene sexyland
scene sexyland2
scene sexyland
scene comedywar39
: {i}It’s back.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}它又来了。{/i}

lines.en: : Uhh...hi?
: Is there some kind of convention going on or something? This is the second giant dolphin I’ve seen today.
lines.zh: : 是有什么活动在办还是怎么的？这是我今天看到的第二只巨型海豚了。

lines.en: : Just leave it alone and it won’t hurt you! That’s what me and Maya have been doing and it hasn’t approached us yet!
lines.zh: : 别去惹它，它就不会伤到你！我和 Maya 一直就是这么做的，它到现在都没靠近过我们！

lines.en: : Why is it even here to begin with? Is it following us?
lines.zh: : 它到底为什么会在这儿？是在跟着我们吗？

lines.en: scene comedywar40
: Quick. Act normal.
lines.zh: : 快。表现得正常点。

lines.en: : Look at me. I’m an average person. I like reading the newspaper and attending municipal court. Go Yankees.
lines.zh: : 看着我。我是个普通人。我喜欢看报纸，也喜欢去市法院旁听。洋基队加油。

lines.en: : Are you excited for the big moment, Sensei? I’ve been practicing my routine all day! Well...when I’m not too busy interviewing the other girls, of course. But {i}most{/i} of the day!
lines.zh: : 老师，你对那个重要时刻期不期待？我练了一整天的段子！当然……除了忙着采访其他女孩的时候不算。但{i}基本上{/i}是一整天！

lines.en: : And I have been doing the laundry. I sure hope my package arrives this week.
lines.zh: : 而我一直在洗衣服。我真希望我的包裹这周能送到。

lines.en: : That’s enough being normal, Tsuneyo. I don’t think the dolphin is watching us anymore.
lines.zh: : 装正常够了，Tsuneyo。我觉得那只海豚已经不看我们了。

lines.en: : That’s good. My knowledge of normal people is extremely limited and I was on the brink of running out of material.
lines.zh: : 那就好。我对正常人的了解极其有限，刚才差点就没词了。

lines.en: : Anyway, I don’t know if {i}excited{/i} is the word to describe how I’m feeling, but I’m definitely looking forward to seeing what you two came up with.
lines.zh: : 总之，我不知道{i}「期待」{/i}这个词能不能形容我现在的感受，但我确实很想看看你们俩准备了什么。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo’s been training for this moment her entire life and Ayane...
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo 为了这一刻练了整整一辈子，而 Ayane……

lines.en: : Well, I assume you’re still looking for that extra {i}reward{/i} if you win?
lines.zh: : 嗯，我猜你赢了的话，还是在要那个额外的{i}奖励{/i}吧？

lines.en: scene comedywar41
: Oh...Uhh...Yeah...
: Extra reward?
lines.zh: : 额外奖励？

lines.en: : It’s nothing! Just a...you know. A thing.
lines.zh: : 没什么！就是……你知道的。一个小东西。

lines.en: : I, too, would like an additional reward if I win. Though, I will likely lose. So perhaps the false promise of said hypothetical reward will be enough for me.
lines.zh: : 如果我赢了，我也想要一份额外的奖励。虽然我很可能会输。所以，也许那份假想奖励的空头承诺，对我来说就足够了。

lines.en: : Sure, Tsuneyo. You can have a bonus reward if you win as well.
lines.zh: : 当然，Tsuneyo。你要是赢了，也可以有一份额外的奖励。

lines.en: scene comedywar42
: No thank you. I do not want it.
lines.zh: : 不用了，谢谢。我不想要。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : I’m sorry, but my mind has already been made up.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，不过我已经决定了。

lines.en: : I think we’re going to be starting soon, so...I’m going to go prepare. I just wanted to talk to you before I went up there and...
lines.zh: : 我想马上就要开始了，所以……我得去准备了。我只是想在站上台之前跟你说说话，然后……

lines.en: : Tell you that I love you...and stuff...
lines.zh: : 告诉你我爱你……之类的……

lines.en: scene comedywar43
: I also love you.
lines.zh: : 我也爱你。

lines.en: : Uhh...Tsuneyo?
lines.zh: : 呃……Tsuneyo？

lines.en: : More than anything in the entire world.
lines.zh: : 胜过这整个世界上的一切。

lines.en: : I have been keeping it a secret this entire time as I did not want to upset anyone. But the burden has become too great to bear and I can no longer keep these feelings inside of me.
lines.zh: : 我一直把这件事藏在心里，因为我不想让任何人难过。但这个负担已经沉重到我再也承受不住，我再也没法把这些感情继续憋在心里了。

lines.en: : I am sorry you had to find out like this.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉，你不得不用这种方式知道。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : I think we’re just waiting for the part where you come out and say that was a joke.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们只是在等你自己说出来，说刚才那些是开玩笑的。

lines.en: : Comedy is all about timing. You could be waiting forever.
lines.zh: : 喜剧讲究的就是时机。你们可能要等到天荒地老。

lines.en: : I feel...weirdly intimidated all of a sudden...
lines.zh: : 我突然觉得……莫名地有压迫感……

lines.en: : What if she’s serious? What if Tsuneyo actually loves you?
lines.zh: : 万一她是认真的呢？万一 Tsuneyo 真的爱你呢？

lines.en: : I do. I can’t live without this man. And, as far as I’m concerned, I didn’t even {i}begin{/i} to live until I met him.
lines.zh: : 我是认真的。没有这个男人我活不下去。而且在我看来，在遇见他之前，我根本就不算真正{i}活过{/i}。

lines.en: : Okay, yeah. This is just a joke.
lines.zh: : 好吧，行了。这就是个玩笑。

lines.en: : It’s not. I love you.
lines.zh: : 不是。我爱你。

lines.en: : Stop saying that. It’s weird.
lines.zh: : 别再说了。很奇怪。

lines.en: scene comedywar44
: Why do you not see me the same way you see the other girls?
lines.zh: : 为什么你不像看其他女孩那样看我？

lines.en: : Have I done something wrong?
lines.zh: : 我做错了什么吗？

lines.en: : Were all of those nights I spent fucking you a mistake?
lines.zh: : 那些和你上床的夜晚，全都是个错误吗？

lines.en: : Ahh...yes...those were the days...
lines.zh: : 啊……是啊……那些日子啊……

lines.en: : Do you love me as well?
lines.zh: : 你也爱我吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不爱。

lines.en: scene comedywar45
: Good. Because I was just joking.
lines.zh: : 很好。因为我刚才只是开玩笑。

lines.en: : This concludes the first segment of Tsuneyo Tojo’s stand-up routine.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo Tojo 单口相声的第一段到此结束。

lines.en: : {i}Unless...{/i}
scene black
Haruka dims the lights and all of the girls who were scattered around the cafe just moments ago scramble to their respective tables.
lines.zh: Haruka 把灯光调暗，片刻前还散落在咖啡馆各处的女孩们纷纷奔回各自的桌子。

lines.en: Not seeing any other open seats, I begin to make my way over to the table Molly and Yasu are sitting at as Imani takes the stage and announces the opening of the competition...
lines.zh: 没看到别的空位，我便朝 Molly 和 Yasu 那桌走去，与此同时 Imani 登上台，宣布比赛开始……

lines.en: scene comedywar46
: Alright, alright, alright! Who’s ready to hear some jokes?!
lines.zh: : 好了，好了，好了！谁准备好听笑话了？！

lines.en: : Woo! Let’s go Ay- guys, come on! How come I’m the only one who ever claps for stuff like this?!
lines.zh: : 哇哦！加油啊 Ay——我是说各位，拜托！为什么每次这种事都只有我一个人在鼓掌？！

lines.en: scene comedywar47
: Thank you, Ami! You’re the first and probably last person who will ever clap for me while I’m standing on a stage completely clothed!
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Ami！你恐怕是第一个、也是最后一个在我穿着衣服站在台上时为我鼓掌的人！

lines.en: : But that’s enough about my questionable history as the top-earning stripper in Bolivia! What we’re {i}really{/i} here to listen to are mediocre jokes from two first-timers that will probably be extremely awkward!
lines.zh: : 不过关于我作为玻利维亚收入最高的脱衣舞娘那段可疑历史，就到此为止吧！我们{i}真正{/i}要听的，是两个新手讲的大概会非常尴尬的中等水平笑话！

lines.en: : But that’s fine! Because if there’s anything {i}I{/i} know about first times, it’s that they’re {i}always{/i} extremely awkward! {i}Especially{/i} when they happen in the back of an ice cream truck.
lines.zh: : 不过没关系！因为要说{i}我{/i}对「第一次」有什么了解，那就是第一次{i}总是{/i}特别尴尬！{i}尤其是{/i}发生在冰淇淋车后座里的那一次。

lines.en: : Are these jokes or...does Imani just have a really weird background story?
lines.zh: : 这算笑话吗……还是说 Imani 的身世背景就是这么诡异？

lines.en: : I have no idea, but I suddenly have a new idea for a smut novel.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，不过我突然有了一个色情小说的新点子。

lines.en: scene comedywar48
: Taking the stage first...the most {i}delectable{/i} chocolate bunny I’ve ever seen- and please don’t tell the cops I said that...it’s Tsuneyo Tojo!
lines.zh: : 首先登台的是……我见过的最{i}美味{/i}的巧克力兔女郎——拜托别去跟警察说我说过这话……她是 Tsuneyo Tojo！

lines.en: scene black
The crowd (Not just Ami) erupts into an actual sea of applause this time as Tsuneyo makes her way over to the stage.
lines.zh: 这一次，人群（不只是 Ami）爆发出真正的一片掌声的海洋，Tsuneyo 则朝舞台走去。

lines.en: Will this be as horrible as I expect it to be?
lines.zh: 会不会像我预想的那么糟？

lines.en: Probably.
lines.zh: 大概会。

lines.en: But at least it’s happening in front of a crowd of her peers instead of a group of strangers.
lines.zh: 但至少这次是当着一群同龄人的面，而不是一群陌生人。
